briefdescription.para: SOC 2 Type II compliance evidence collector for the security module.

detaileddescription.para: Aggregates evidence from the audit log, key-management subsystem, and RBAC registry into a structured bundle ready for external auditors.

sect2.title: Retention policy
sect2.para: The default retention period is 365 days (12 months). collect() sets SecurityEvidenceBundle::within_retention_window = false when the requested window extends beyond now - retention_period, signalling that evidence in that range may have been purged.
